full_judgment:
2. The facts, leading to the filing of this petition, in brief, are that the petitioners instituted a suit being Title Suit No. 385 of 1988 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, Second Court, Dhaka, praying for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession of the suit land. 

 8. We have gone through the judgment passed by the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division. It appears that in reversing the findings of fact arrived at by the appellate Court below, the learned Judge considered the depositions of each and every witness and came to a definite finding that, firstly, Osman Miah and Osman Gani are the same person; secondly, the possession and title of the defendants are supported by documentary and oral evidence; thirdly, the deeds of the title of the defendants were remained unchallenged; fourthly, the plaintiff failed to prove his title and possession in the suit-land and also failed to prove his case of dispossession as alleged in the plaint; and finally, the learned Judge held that the plaintiffs suit, praying for a decree for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession is not maintainable without seeking a further declaration that the deeds of the defendants are all forged, void, inoperative and not acted upon.
